email_subject: Application - Social Media Expert at NTT DATA
email_body:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to apply for the Social Media Expert role with NTT DATA, supporting the European Commission in Brussels. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and content creation, I have developed skills that align closely with your requirements.

At Episto, I manage on-page SEO, create keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites for clients. On my project mirook.com, I designed and built a multi-page site, implemented social media integration (Instagram/Facebook), and used analytics to improve visibility. I am comfortable with social media platforms, content planning, and performance reporting. My experience with Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Meta tools enables me to derive actionable insights.

I am autonomous, detail-oriented, and eager to contribute to the European Commission's social media strategy. I am confident that my skills in content creation, community management, and analytics would be an asset to your team.

Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the Social Media Expert position at NTT DATA, supporting the European Commission in Brussels. With a strong foundation in digital marketing, SEO, and content creation, I am eager to bring my skills to a role that combines strategic social media management with impactful European projects.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I handle on-page SEO, keyword research, and content publishing for client websites. I also build and maintain WordPress sites, ensuring they are optimized for both search engines and user engagement. This experience has honed my ability to translate complex information into clear, accessible content—a skill directly applicable to communicating policy language effectively.

On my personal project, mirook.com, I designed and built a multi-page website, integrating social media platforms (Instagram and Facebook) to amplify its reach. I implemented structured data and technical SEO/GEO audits, which improved search visibility. This project taught me the value of data-driven decisions and the importance of monitoring performance to refine strategies.

I am proficient in analytics tools such as Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Ahrefs, and I have experience with Meta Business Suite for advertising. I am autonomous, organized, and detail-oriented, with excellent verbal communication skills. I thrive in collaborative environments and am keen to work with internal teams and external influencers to develop and execute social media campaigns that resonate with audiences.

I am particularly drawn to this role because it offers the opportunity to contribute to the European Commission's communication efforts, ensuring that their messages reach and engage citizens effectively. I am confident that my creativity, analytical mindset, and commitment to continuous learning would make me a valuable addition to your team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to NTT DATA and the European Commission.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
